polymer.basis: Trinseo TYRIL 790, an unfilled general-purpose styrene-acrylonitrile resin: density 1.08 g/cm3 (Technical Information, p. 1), against an apparent density of 0.69 for the pellets. The range has no width because every producer grade found publishes the same figure; INEOS Styrolution's Luran 368R and its ten-grade Lustran guide all give 1.08 g/cm3 to ISO 1183. SAN is amorphous and has no melting point.
